dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, did you visit the museum recently?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, dɪd juː ˈvɪzɪt ðə mjuˈziːəm ˈriːsəntli?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I went there the other day with Fah.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈwɛnt ˈðɛr ði ˈʌðər ˈdeɪ wɪð ˈfɑː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Old photos of Bangkok from the nineteenth century.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊld ˈfoʊtoʊz əv ˈbæŋkɑːk frəm ðə ˌnaɪnˈtiːnθ ˈsɛntʃəri.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Interesting! Bangkok was very different in the past.
dialogue.reading: ˈɪntrəstɪŋ! ˈbæŋkɑːk wʌz ˈvɛri ˈdɪfərənt ɪn ðə ˈpæst.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. A hundred and fifty years ago, there were no cars! People traveled by boat.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ə ˈhʌndrəd ənd ˈfɪfti ˈjɪrz əˈɡoʊ, ðɛr wɜːr ˈnoʊ ˈkɑːrz! ˈpiːpəl ˈtrævəld baɪ ˈboʊt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's right. I came to Bangkok in 2012, and I took boats every day, too!
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. aɪ ˈkeɪm tə ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪn ˈtwɛnti ˈtwɛlv, ənd aɪ ˈtʊk ˈboʊts ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ, ˈtuː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? Last week, I took a boat to class, too!
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈlæst ˈwiːk, aɪ ˈtʊk ə ˈboʊt tə ˈklæs, ˈtuː!
